comparison.objective: Restock a twin-roll tissue dispenser by moving the stub to reserve, installing a new primary roll, and locking the cover; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Roll removal/insertion, spindle allocation, cover closure, and key/lock handling versus fine hex engagement, captive setscrew manipulation, collar tuning, and guarded dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Old roll must occupy reserve, new roll primary, cover closed and locked. Candidate instead evaluates stopping travel, forces, rebound, and retained adjustment over two cycles.
comparison.reason: The shared generic notion of locking does not make consumable restocking equivalent to dynamic commissioning.
